name: nginx-multisite
description: Installs and configures Nginx for three SSL-enabled virtual hosts, including static content, security hardening, firewall and SSH restrictions, Fail2ban, sysctl settings, and development certificates.

name: cache
description: Installs and enables Memcached and Redis, configures Redis on port 6379 with authentication and logging, and applies a post-configuration compatibility workaround.

name: fastapi-tutorial
description: Installs Python and PostgreSQL prerequisites, deploys the FastAPI tutorial application, provisions its database and environment configuration, and manages a systemd service running Uvicorn.
